description:
Show good and bad code side by side. Paste two snippets, pick a theme, and export a ready-to-share PNG with a Do or Don't badge.

Great for:
• README files and documentation
• Blog posts and articles
• Code reviews and style guides
• Teaching and presentations
• Social posts

Customize your way:
• Syntax highlighting for 19 languages
• 11 syntax themes, dark and light
• Badge position, style, size, icon, and custom label
• Font size from 10 to 24 pt
• Optional title bar for cleaner exports

Export:
• High-resolution 2x PNG
• Side-by-side or stacked layout
• Save to a folder you choose
• Reveal in Finder from the confirmation toast

Built for Mac:
• VoiceOver support
• Reduced motion support

Privacy first:
• All processing happens locally on your Mac
• No data collected or sent anywhere
• Works completely offline
promotionalText: Make Do and Don't code images for docs, blog posts and reviews. 19 languages, 11 themes, crisp 2x PNG. Private and offline.
whatsNew:
• Redesigned About window with a link to the latest version
• Updated dependencies and stability improvements
